evidence.quote: Durata: 3 anni Tipo di accesso: procedure differenziate di ammissione
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Sciences Class L-9 – Industrial Engineering | 3 Years | 180 ECTS

If you are a non-EU citizen residing abroad, you must submit a pre-enrolment application to request an entry visa for study purposes in order to enter Italy. You must submit the pre-enrolment application on the Universitaly platform (www.universitaly.it)
The pre-enrollment application on Universitaly is mandatory for all non-EU applicants not residing in Italy

notes: Tuition left out: no page states one EUR amount for a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU living abroad for this programme; the pages only refer to fee calculation by ISEE/income band and point to external tuition pages not supplied. ApplicationChannel it-universitaly chosen because non-EU applicants living abroad must pre-enrol on Universitaly; the programme's own application-assessment route via Delphi is described only as a general university procedure, and the programme itself is described as "procedure differenziate di ammissione".

evidence.quote: The qualification must be obtained at the end of a school period equal to at least 12 years of schooling and allow access at the universities of the country where the qualification was obtained

note.fr: Une preuve de connaissances obligatoire est prévue pour l'admission ; elle ne bloque pas l'inscription.
note.en: A compulsory knowledge assessment test is required for admission; it does not prevent enrollment.

evidence.quote: Accesso libero con prova di verifica obbligatoria delle conoscenze richieste per l'ammissione al corso. L'esito della prova non preclude la possibilità di immatricolarsi

note.fr: Préinscription obligatoire sur Universitaly avant le 31 juillet pour les candidats non-UE résidant à l'étranger.
note.en: Mandatory pre-enrollment on Universitaly by July 31 for non-EU applicants living abroad.

evidence.quote: The deadline to submit UniversItaly pre-enrollment is July 31 except for programs that require entrance exam, in that case the pre-enrollment must be submitted before the test.
